claude_proposed_widenings.name: upgrade_feature_damage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The damage clause ('increases to 2d10') replaces the dice of a named sibling feature's extra-damage instance, not adds bonus damage on top. modify_damage_numeric is additive and general; it cannot express a targeted die-replacement upgrade to a specific named feature's existing damage atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The extra damage of your Brutal Strike increases to 2d10.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: extend_feature_rider_count
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The 'two effects' clause increases the number of on-hit rider options the barbarian may select from the Brutal Strike feature in one use. No atom models a meta-count increase over the activation choices of a named sibling feature. This is not grant_extra_action (different economy), not scale_attack_count (no attack count), and not any passive grant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can use two different Brutal Strike effects whenever you use your Brutal Strike feature.
